<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
    <title>Corrida Customizada - Versão Oficial com Editor de Pistas</title>
    <!-- Tailwind CSS -->
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <!-- Font Awesome -->
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
    <!-- Google Fonts -->
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Russo+One&family=Teko:wght@500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <style>
        * {
            user-select: none;
            -webkit-user-select: none;
            touch-action: manipulation;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Teko', sans-serif;
            background-color: #06190f;
            color: #fff;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .font-russo {
            font-family: 'Russo One', sans-serif;
        }

        .glass-panel {
            background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.92);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(229, 0, 136, 0.4);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 32px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
        }

        .racing-btn {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e50088 0%, #BA9C02 100%);
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(229, 0, 136, 0.4);
        }

        .racing-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(229, 0, 136, 0.7);
        }

        .racing-btn:active {
            transform: translateY(1px);
        }

        .editor-btn {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0ea5e9 0%, #10b981 100%);
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.35);
        }

        .editor-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.6);
        }

        #editorCanvas {
            touch-action: none;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-white relative">

    <!-- Game Container -->
    <div id="game-container" class="relative w-full max-w-5xl h-screen md:h-[92vh] md:max-h-[800px] bg-[#006838] md:rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-emerald-500/30 shadow-2xl flex flex-col">

        <!-- Canvas Principal -->
        <canvas id="gameCanvas" class="w-full h-full block bg-[#006838]"></canvas>

        <!-- HUD da Corrida -->
        <div id="hud" class="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 p-4 flex justify-between items-start pointer-events-none hidden z-10">
            <!-- Posição, Volta e Checkpoint -->
            <div class="flex gap-2 sm:gap-3">
                <div class="bg-slate-900/90 px-3 py-1.5 sm:px-4 sm:py-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/40 flex flex-col items-center">
                    <span class="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-amber-400 font-russo uppercase">Posição</span>
                    <span id="pos-display" class="font-russo text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-white">1º / 4</span>
                </div>
                <div class="bg-slate-900/90 px-3 py-1.5 sm:px-4 sm:py-2 rounded-xl border border-cyan-500/40 flex flex-col items-center">
                    <span class="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-cyan-400 font-russo uppercase">Volta</span>
                    <span id="lap-display" class="font-russo text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-white">1 / 3</span>
                </div>
                <div class="bg-slate-900/90 px-3 py-1.5 sm:px-4 sm:py-2 rounded-xl border border-pink-500/40 flex flex-col items-center">
                    <span class="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-pink-400 font-russo uppercase">Checkpoint</span>
                    <span id="cp-display" class="font-russo text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-pink-300">1 / 5</span>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Minimapa e Velocímetro -->
            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div class="bg-slate-900/90 p-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/60 hidden sm:block">
                    <canvas id="minimapCanvas" width="140" height="100" class="block"></canvas>
                </div>
                <div class="bg-slate-900/90 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-red-500/40 flex flex-col items-end">
                    <span class="text-xs text-red-400 font-russo uppercase">Velocidade</span>
                    <div class="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                        <span id="speed-display" class="font-russo text-3xl text-white">0</span>
                        <span class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-russo">KM/H</span>
                    </div>
                    <span id="time-display" class="text-xs font-russo text-cyan-400 mt-1">0.0s</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Contadores de Alerta de Checkpoint -->
        <div id="cp-toast" class="absolute top-24 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-pink-600/90 text-white font-russo px-4 py-1 rounded-full text-sm tracking-wider uppercase hidden z-20 shadow-lg pointer-events-none">
            Checkpoint Validado!
        </div>

        <!-- Timer Regressivo de Largada -->
        <div id="countdown-overlay" class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 z-20 hidden pointer-events-none">
            <span id="countdown-text" class="font-russo text-8xl md:text-9xl text-amber-400 drop-shadow-[0_10px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] animate-bounce">3</span>
        </div>

        <!-- Tela de Início (Menu Inicial) -->
        <div id="start-screen" class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black z-40 overflow-hidden" style="container-type:size;">
            <!-- Imagem do SVG apenas redimensionada, mantendo a proporção original (4961x3508) -->
            <div class="relative" style="width:min(100cqw, calc(100cqh * 4961 / 3508)); aspect-ratio:4961 / 3508; container-type:inline-size;">
                <img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="Corrida Paint - Tela de Início" class="block w-full h-full pointer-events-none select-none">

                <!-- Botão Jogar sobre a área verde, escalando junto com a imagem -->
                <button id="btn-play-game" aria-label="Jogar" class="absolute z-10 flex items-center justify-center group cursor-pointer transition-transform duration-200 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 focus:outline-none" style="left:30%; top:79%; width:36cqw; height:10.2cqw; transform-origin:center; translate:-50% -50%;">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 600 170" class="w-full h-full drop-shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.45)] group-hover:drop-shadow-[0_10px_28px_rgba(244,123,22,0.85)] transition-all" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
                        <rect x="10" y="10" width="580" height="150" rx="75" ry="75" fill="#f47b16" />
                    </svg>
                    <span class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center font-russo uppercase tracking-widest text-white pointer-events-none" style="font-size:4cqw; gap:1.5cqw;">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i> JOGAR
                    </span>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Garagem / Menu Principal -->
        <div id="garage-screen" class="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col justify-between p-6 bg-slate-950/95 z-30 overflow-y-auto hidden">
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-flag-checkered text-3xl text-pink-500"></i>
                    <h1 class="font-russo text-2xl md:text-3xl text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 via-amber-400 to-emerald-400 uppercase">
                        CORRIDA CUSTOMIZADA
                    </h1>
                </div>
                <div class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-russo hidden md:block">Personalize, crie pistas e vença!</div>
            </div>

            <!-- Customização -->
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 my-auto py-4 items-center">
                <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/70 p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
                    <span class="text-xs font-russo text-slate-400 mb-2 tracking-widest uppercase">Visualização do Veículo</span>
                    <canvas id="previewCanvas" width="200" height="240" class="bg-slate-950/80 rounded-xl border border-pink-500/20 my-2"></canvas>
                </div>

                <div class="flex flex-col gap-4 bg-slate-900/50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-pink-400 font-russo text-xs mb-2"><i class="fa-solid fa-car-side mr-1"></i>ESCOLHA O VEÍCULO</label>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5" id="opts-vehicle">
                            <button data-model="tokyo" class="vehicle-btn bg-pink-500/20 border-2 border-pink-500 text-white font-russo text-xs p-2.5 rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 transition">
                                <canvas id="thumb-tokyo" width="84" height="44" class="block"></canvas>
                                <span>Supra SZ A80</span>
                            </button>
                            <button data-model="alfetta" class="vehicle-btn bg-slate-800/90 border-2 border-slate-700 text-slate-300 font-russo text-xs p-2.5 rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 hover:border-pink-500/60 transition">
                                <canvas id="thumb-alfetta" width="84" height="44" class="block"></canvas>
                                <span>Alfetta 159</span>
                            </button>
                            <button data-model="uno" class="vehicle-btn bg-slate-800/90 border-2 border-slate-700 text-slate-300 font-russo text-xs p-2.5 rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 hover:border-pink-500/60 transition">
                                <canvas id="thumb-uno" width="84" height="44" class="block"></canvas>
                                <span>Uno c/ Escada</span>
                            </button>
                            <button data-model="formula" class="vehicle-btn bg-slate-800/90 border-2 border-slate-700 text-slate-300 font-russo text-xs p-2.5 rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 hover:border-pink-500/60 transition">
                                <canvas id="thumb-formula" width="84" height="44" class="block"></canvas>
                                <span>Fórmula 1</span>
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label for="car-color-picker" class="block text-pink-400 font-russo text-xs mb-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-palette mr-1"></i>PINTURA</label>
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-700 p-2 rounded-lg" id="opts-color">
                            <input type="color" id="car-color-picker" value="#e50088" class="w-10 h-8 rounded cursor-pointer bg-transparent border-0 p-0">
                            <span id="car-color-hex" class="font-russo text-sm text-slate-200 uppercase tracking-wider">#E50088</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                <button id="btn-goto-editor" class="editor-btn py-3.5 px-4 rounded-xl font-russo text-base uppercase tracking-wider text-white flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-pen-ruler text-lg"></i> EDITOR DE PISTAS
                </button>
                <button id="btn-goto-track-select" class="racing-btn sm:col-span-2 py-3.5 px-4 rounded-xl font-russo text-lg uppercase tracking-wider text-white flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-flag-checkered text-xl"></i> ESCOLHER PISTA E CORRER
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Tela de Seleção de Pistas -->
        <div id="track-select-screen" class="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col justify-between p-6 bg-slate-950/95 z-30 overflow-y-auto hidden">
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-map-location-dot text-3xl text-pink-500"></i>
                    <h1 class="font-russo text-2xl md:text-3xl text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 via-amber-400 to-emerald-400">
                        SELEÇÃO DE CIRCUITO
                    </h1>
                </div>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <button id="btn-open-editor-from-select" class="text-cyan-300 hover:text-white font-russo text-sm flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-900 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-cyan-500/40">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-pen-ruler"></i> Editar Custom
                    </button>
                    <button id="btn-back-to-garage" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-white font-russo text-sm flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-900 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></i> Garagem
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 my-auto py-4">
                <!-- Pista 1 -->
                <div data-track="track1" class="track-card bg-slate-900 border-2 border-pink-500 p-3 rounded-2xl cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center hover:border-pink-400 transition shadow-lg relative group">
                    <canvas id="map-preview-track1" width="200" height="140" class="bg-[#006838] rounded-xl border border-slate-800 my-1 w-full h-auto"></canvas>
                    <h3 class="font-russo text-base text-pink-400 mt-1">Pista 1</h3>
                    <p class="text-slate-400 text-xs text-center font-russo mt-1">Circuito clássico técnico com curvas rápidas e 5 checkpoints.</p>
                </div>

                <!-- Pista 2 -->
                <div data-track="track2" class="track-card bg-slate-900 border-2 border-slate-800 p-3 rounded-2xl cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center hover:border-pink-500 transition shadow-lg relative group">
                    <canvas id="map-preview-track2" width="200" height="140" class="bg-[#006838] rounded-xl border border-slate-800 my-1 w-full h-auto"></canvas>
                    <h3 class="font-russo text-base text-slate-200 mt-1">Pista 2</h3>
                    <p class="text-slate-400 text-xs text-center font-russo mt-1">Retas de alta velocidade combinadas com chicanes fechadas.</p>
                </div>

                <!-- Pista 3 -->
                <div data-track="track3" class="track-card bg-slate-900 border-2 border-slate-800 p-3 rounded-2xl cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center hover:border-pink-500 transition shadow-lg relative group">
                    <canvas id="map-preview-track3" width="200" height="140" class="bg-[#006838] rounded-xl border border-slate-800 my-1 w-full h-auto"></canvas>
                    <h3 class="font-russo text-base text-slate-200 mt-1">Pista 3 (Fish)</h3>
                    <p class="text-slate-400 text-xs text-center font-russo mt-1">Traçado desafiador com sequências contínuas de curvas.</p>
                </div>

                <!-- Pista Customizada -->
                <div data-track="custom" id="card-custom-track" class="track-card bg-slate-900 border-2 border-slate-800 p-3 rounded-2xl cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center hover:border-cyan-400 transition shadow-lg relative group">
                    <span class="absolute top-2 right-2 bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/40 text-[10px] font-russo px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">CUSTOM</span>
                    <canvas id="map-preview-custom" width="200" height="140" class="bg-[#006838] rounded-xl border border-slate-800 my-1 w-full h-auto"></canvas>
                    <h3 id="custom-track-card-title" class="font-russo text-base text-slate-200 mt-1">Pista Customizada</h3>
                    <p id="custom-track-card-desc" class="text-slate-400 text-xs text-center font-russo mt-1">Criada no Editor de Pistas. Clique no botão acima para desenhar!</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <button id="btn-start-race" class="racing-btn w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl font-russo text-lg uppercase tracking-wider text-white flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-play text-xl"></i> INICIAR CORRIDA NA PISTA 1
            </button>
        </div>

        <!-- Tela do Editor de Pistas -->
        <div id="track-editor-screen" class="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col justify-between p-4 sm:p-5 bg-slate-950/98 z-30 hidden">
            <!-- Cabeçalho do Editor -->
            <div class="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-2.5">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-pen-ruler text-2xl text-cyan-400"></i>
                    <div>
                        <h2 class="font-russo text-xl sm:text-2xl text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 to-emerald-400 leading-none">
                            EDITOR DE PISTAS
                        </h2>
                        <span class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-russo">Clique na área verde para adicionar pontos, arraste para ajustar</span>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <input id="custom-track-name-input" type="text" maxlength="24" value="Minha Pista" placeholder="Nome da Pista"
                        class="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 focus:border-cyan-400 outline-none rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-russo text-white w-36 sm:w-44">
                    <button id="btn-editor-back" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-white font-russo text-sm flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-900 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></i> Voltar
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Barra de Ferramentas do Editor -->
            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 my-2 bg-slate-900/90 p-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5" id="editor-tools">
                    <button data-tool="add" class="ed-tool-btn bg-cyan-500/20 border border-cyan-400 text-cyan-300 font-russo text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-plus-circle"></i> Pontos / Mover
                    </button>
                    <button data-tool="delete" class="ed-tool-btn bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-slate-300 font-russo text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-eraser"></i> Remover Ponto
                    </button>
                    <button data-tool="checkpoint" class="ed-tool-btn bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-slate-300 font-russo text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-flag"></i> Checkpoints (5)
                    </button>
                    <button data-tool="start" class="ed-tool-btn bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-slate-300 font-russo text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-flag-checkered"></i> Largada
                    </button>
                </div>

                <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                    <button id="btn-ed-auto-cp" class="bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 text-amber-300 font-russo text-xs px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg" title="Distribuir 5 checkpoints automaticamente">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles mr-1"></i> Auto CPs
                    </button>
                    <button id="btn-ed-reverse" class="bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 text-slate-200 font-russo text-xs px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg" title="Inverter sentido da pista">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-arrows-rotate mr-1"></i> Inverter
                    </button>
                    <button id="btn-ed-preset" class="bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 text-emerald-300 font-russo text-xs px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg" title="Carregar formato oval base">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-shapes mr-1"></i> Oval Base
                    </button>
                    <button id="btn-ed-clear" class="bg-slate-800 hover:bg-red-950/70 border border-slate-700 text-red-400 font-russo text-xs px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg" title="Limpar todos os pontos">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-trash mr-1"></i> Limpar
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Área de Desenho do Editor -->
            <div id="editor-canvas-wrapper" class="relative flex-1 min-h-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 overflow-hidden p-2">
                <canvas id="editorCanvas" class="rounded-lg shadow-inner cursor-crosshair"></canvas>
                <!-- Dica flutuante do modo ativo -->
                <div id="editor-hint" class="absolute bottom-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-slate-950/90 border border-slate-700/80 text-slate-200 font-russo text-xs px-3.5 py-1 rounded-full pointer-events-none whitespace-nowrap">
                    Clique para adicionar pontos (mín. 4). Arraste pontos existentes para ajustar a curva.
                </div>
                <!-- Alerta interno do editor -->
                <div id="editor-toast" class="absolute top-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-pink-600 text-white font-russo text-xs px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full shadow-lg hidden pointer-events-none">
                    Aviso
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Rodapé do Editor -->
            <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-2 mt-2.5">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs font-russo text-slate-400">
                    <span><span class="inline-block w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#e40587] mr-1"></span>Largada / CP 1</span>
                    <span><span class="inline-block w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#b89d30] mr-1"></span>Checkpoints 2-5</span>
                    <span id="editor-point-count" class="text-cyan-400">Pontos: 0</span>
                </div>

                <div class="flex gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
                    <button id="btn-ed-save" class="bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-cyan-500/50 text-cyan-300 font-russo text-sm px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl flex-1 sm:flex-initial flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-floppy-disk"></i> SALVAR PISTA
                    </button>
                    <button id="btn-ed-test-race" class="racing-btn font-russo text-sm px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-white flex-1 sm:flex-initial flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i> SALVAR E CORRER
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Tela de Fim de Jogo -->
        <div id="game-over-screen" class="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 bg-slate-950/95 z-40 hidden">
            <div class="glass-panel p-8 rounded-2xl text-center max-w-md w-full border border-pink-500/40">
                <i id="end-icon" class="fa-solid fa-trophy text-5xl text-amber-400 mb-3"></i>
                <h2 id="end-title" class="font-russo text-3xl font-bold text-amber-400 mb-1">CORRIDA CONCLUÍDA!</h2>
                <p id="end-desc" class="text-slate-400 text-sm mb-6">Você completou todas as 3 voltas!</p>

                <div class="bg-slate-900/90 rounded-xl p-4 mb-6 border border-slate-800 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div>
                        <div class="text-xs font-russo text-slate-400 uppercase">Posição Final</div>
                        <div id="final-pos" class="font-russo text-3xl text-amber-400">1º</div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <div class="text-xs font-russo text-slate-400 uppercase">Tempo Total</div>
                        <div id="final-time" class="font-russo text-3xl text-cyan-400">0.0s</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="flex flex-col gap-3">
                    <button id="btn-restart" class="racing-btn w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-russo text-base uppercase text-white">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate-right mr-2"></i> Correr Novamente
                    </button>
                    <button id="btn-back-garage" class="bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl font-russo text-slate-300">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-wrench mr-2"></i> Voltar à Garagem
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Touch Controls (Mobile) -->
        <div id="touch-controls" class="absolute bottom-4 left-0 right-0 px-6 flex justify-between items-center z-10 pointer-events-none hidden md:hidden">
            <div class="flex gap-3 pointer-events-auto">
                <button id="btn-touch-left" class="w-16 h-16 bg-slate-800/80 active:bg-pink-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-white text-2xl border border-slate-600 shadow-lg">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></i>
                </button>
                <button id="btn-touch-right" class="w-16 h-16 bg-slate-800/80 active:bg-pink-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-white text-2xl border border-slate-600 shadow-lg">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i>
                </button>
            </div>
            <div class="flex gap-3 pointer-events-auto">
                <button id="btn-touch-brake" class="w-14 h-14 bg-slate-800/80 active:bg-red-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xl border border-slate-600 shadow-lg">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-ban"></i>
                </button>
                <button id="btn-touch-accel" class="w-16 h-16 bg-gradient-to-br from-pink-500 to-amber-500 active:from-pink-600 active:to-amber-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-white text-2xl border border-pink-400/50 shadow-lg font-russo">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-gauge-high"></i>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

    </div>

    <!-- Script Principal -->
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        const previewCanvas = document.getElementById('previewCanvas');
        const previewCtx = previewCanvas.getContext('2d');
        const minimapCanvas = document.getElementById('minimapCanvas');
        const minimapCtx = minimapCanvas.getContext('2d');
        const container = document.getElementById('game-container');

        function resizeCanvas() {
            canvas.width = container.clientWidth;
            canvas.height = container.clientHeight;
            if (!document.getElementById('track-editor-screen').classList.contains('hidden')) {
                resizeEditorCanvas();
            }
        }
        window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
        resizeCanvas();

        const STATES = { GARAGE: 0, RACING: 1, GAMEOVER: 2 };
        let gameState = STATES.GARAGE;
        let isCountingDown = false;
        let selectedTrackKey = 'track1';

        const SVG_NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
        const SVG_W = 842.89;          // viewBox comum aos 3 SVGs
        const SVG_H = 596.28;

        // ---- Ajustes de jogabilidade ----
        const MAP_SCALE = 4.0;         // 1 unidade do SVG = 4 px no mundo do jogo
        const TRACK_WIDTH = 64;        // largura do asfalto dentro do jogo (px)
        const SAMPLE_SPACING = 8;      // distância entre pontos da linha central (px)
        const CAR_SCALE = 0.75;        // tamanho dos carros na pista
        const AI_LOOKAHEAD = 12;       // quantos pontos à frente a IA mira

        // ---- Cores tiradas dos SVGs ----
        const COL_GRASS = '#006838';
        const COL_FIELD_EDGE = '#231f20';
        const COL_GOLD = '#b89d30';    // checkpoints
        const COL_PINK = '#e40587';    // largada/chegada

        // =====================================================================
        // PISTAS OFICIAIS + PISTA CUSTOMIZADA
        // =====================================================================
        const trackPresets = {
            track1: {
                name: 'Pista 1',
                file: 'Pista_1.svg',
                d: 'M128.62,419.8c-46.26-8.44-82.15-127.12-47.61-225.16C106.58,122.07,175.43,47.5,224.7,58.71c57.8,13.15,60.04,137.84,108.2,139.26,15.86.47,30.19-14.98,58.86-45.87,47.6-51.29,59.84-88.57,72.71-85.89,19.05,3.96-3.91,86.41,33.76,110.08,30.88,19.4,66.06-23.58,129.84-16.68,52.81,5.71,98.94,42.78,122.05,82.56,53.82,92.64-18.98,196.92-22.51,201.81-78.5,108.77-252.06,119.14-267.47,89.23-17.32-33.6,160.66-126.5,137.63-178.74-11.32-25.68-68.32-34.96-109.07-21.4-40.08,13.33-43.69,41.86-109.07,97.57-40.43,34.45-65.89,56.15-86.56,49.2-38.06-12.8-18.35-108.77-54.53-120.92-34.19-11.48-69.38,68.28-109.93,60.88Z',
                svgRoad: 12,
                svgBorder: 16,
                asphalt: '#414042',
                startMarker: 0,
                markers: [
                    { x1: 59.63, y1: 265.55, x2: 74.85, y2: 266.32 },
                    { x1: 346.21, y1: 186.2, x2: 354.11, y2: 199.24 },
                    { x1: 752.38, y1: 231.34, x2: 739.35, y2: 239.25 },
                    { x1: 557.99, y1: 416.29, x2: 569.59, y2: 426.19 },
                    { x1: 385.54, y1: 415.64, x2: 395.88, y2: 426.84 }
                ]
            },
            track2: {
                name: 'Pista 2',
                file: 'Pista2_1.svg',
                d: 'M59.28,50.16c6.73-24.61,103.81-35.66,185.14,0,82.7,36.26,80.49,90.73,141.22,103.38,92.93,19.35,144.53-98.52,229.05-77.03,43.38,11.03,68.11,56.45,117.57,147.3,55.8,102.5,89.32,164.06,65.54,208.78-23.69,44.55-86.15,38.38-264.86,57.43-187.73,20.01-322.64,48.56-325,37.16-2.43-11.71,137.05-55.5,284.46-150.68,22.58-14.58,59.15-39.28,60.81-75,1.42-30.49-22.61-68.9-53.38-76.35-73.34-17.77-117.14,156.7-245.95,177.03-92.78,14.64-190.72-56.83-185.14-89.19,8.02-46.45,230.88-20.96,241.89-73.65C323.13,179.57,47.28,94.05,59.28,50.16Z',
                svgRoad: 12,
                svgBorder: 16,
                asphalt: '#424142',
                startMarker: 1,
                markers: [
                    { x1: 247.7, y1: 43.29, x2: 241.14, y2: 57.04 },
                    { x1: 192.2, y1: 270.96, x2: 192.19, y2: 286.21 },
                    { x1: 719.68, y1: 185.03, x2: 707.03, y2: 193.53 },
                    { x1: 468.73, y1: 220.52, x2: 475.16, y2: 234.34 },
                    { x1: 674.48, y1: 469.15, x2: 678.57, y2: 483.84 }
                ]
            },
            track3: {
                name: 'Pista 3 (Fish)',
                file: 'PIsta3_1_fish_note.svg',
                d: 'M68.84,71.9c-22.57,20.65,47.77,81.44,50.27,175.88,2.82,106.9-84.24,145.6-59.06,216.38,17.82,50.1,80.02,93.42,136.35,81.59,50.92-10.69,87-64.24,91.05-111.12,5.41-62.6-48.56-86.79-35.76-144.54,10.97-49.49,59.68-72.65,63.47-74.38,48.96-22.37,107.77-5.33,142,31.47,32.31,34.75,49.08,94.08,26.39,125.72-21.84,30.45-70.13,10.85-96.13,44.73-20.82,27.13-16.27,74.12,8.17,100.33,36.89,39.56,111.78,31.45,148.91,0,48.08-40.71,23.58-112.68,57.18-124.51,38.52-13.55,82.35,76.92,130.69,65.28,39.42-9.49,68.84-83.76,48.38-130.55-14-32.01-43.18-32.51-52.78-67.09-10.93-39.4,19.62-65.21,6.28-79.78-15.26-16.67-75.4-4.89-106.81,31.43-41.71,48.22-14.68,118.75-25.76,120.88-13.21,2.53-70.09-94.86-32.67-152.91,28.45-44.14,91.74-41.21,91.73-61.65,0-27.9-117.96-48.76-146.4-53.79-57.9-10.24-105.1-18.59-167.76-11.48-93.16,10.56-111.55,42.93-184.73,34.45-54.96-6.37-79.49-28.67-92.99-16.32Z',
                dBorder: 'M69.06,71.9c-22.57,20.65,47.77,81.44,50.27,175.88,2.82,106.9-84.24,145.6-59.06,216.38,17.82,50.1,80.02,93.42,136.35,81.59,50.92-10.69,87-64.24,91.05-111.12,5.41-62.6-48.56-86.79-35.76-144.54,10.97-49.49,59.68-72.65,63.47-74.38,48.96-22.37,107.77-5.33,142,31.47,32.31,34.75,49.08,94.08,26.39,125.72-21.84,30.45-70.13,10.85-96.13,44.73-20.82,27.13-16.27,74.12,8.17,100.33,36.89,39.56,111.78,31.45,148.91,0,48.08-40.71,23.58-112.68,57.18-124.51,38.52-13.55,82.35,76.92,130.69,65.28,39.42-9.49,68.84-83.76,48.38-130.55-14-32.01-43.18-32.51-52.78-67.09-10.93-39.4,19.62-65.21,6.28-79.78-15.26-16.67-75.4-4.89-106.81,31.43-41.71,48.22-14.68,118.75-25.76,120.88-13.21,2.53-70.09-94.86-32.67-152.91,28.45-44.14,91.74-41.21,91.73-61.65,0-27.9-117.96-48.76-146.4-53.79-57.9-10.24-105.1-18.59-167.76-11.48-93.16,10.56-111.55,42.93-184.73,34.45-54.96-6.37-79.49-28.67-92.99-16.32Z',
                svgRoad: 12,
                svgBorder: 15,
                asphalt: '#434143',
                startMarker: 0,
                markers: [
                    { x1: 62.1, y1: 389.68, x2: 75.39, y2: 397.14 },
                    { x1: 448.17, y1: 46.91, x2: 446.28, y2: 62.04 },
                    { x1: 596.1, y1: 272.8, x2: 611.33, y2: 273.57 },
                    { x1: 576.29, y1: 417.83, x2: 590.71, y2: 422.76 },
                    { x1: 350.95, y1: 198.56, x2: 351.62, y2: 213.79 }
                ]
            }
        };

        function buildTrackGeometry(preset) {
            const probe = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'path');
            probe.setAttribute('d', preset.d);
            const total = probe.getTotalLength();
            const n = Math.max(40, Math.round(total * MAP_SCALE / SAMPLE_SPACING));

            const raw = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                const p = probe.getPointAtLength(total * i / n);
                raw.push({ x: p.x * MAP_SCALE, y: p.y * MAP_SCALE });
            }

            const nearestIdx = (x, y) => {
                let best = 0, bestD = Infinity;
                for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    const d = (raw[i].x - x) ** 2 + (raw[i].y - y) ** 2;
                    if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i; }
                }
                return best;
            };

            const found = preset.markers.map(m =>
                nearestIdx(((m.x1 + m.x2) / 2) * MAP_SCALE, ((m.y1 + m.y2) / 2) * MAP_SCALE));

            const startIdx = found[preset.startMarker];
            const path = raw.slice(startIdx).concat(raw.slice(0, startIdx));

            const cps = found
                .map(f => (f - startIdx + n) % n)
                .sort((a, b) => a - b)
                .map((idx, i) => {
                    const p = path[idx], q = path[(idx + 1) % n];
                    return { id: i + 1, index: idx, x: p.x, y: p.y, angle: Math.atan2(q.y - p.y, q.x - p.x) };
                });

            return {
                path,
                checkpoints: cps,
                path2D: new Path2D(preset.d),
                border2D: new Path2D(preset.dBorder || preset.d),
                borderPx: ((preset.svgBorder - preset.svgRoad) / 2) * MAP_SCALE,
                edgeLimit: TRACK_WIDTH / 2 + ((preset.svgBorder - preset.svgRoad) / 2) * MAP_SCALE
            };
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // EDITOR DE PISTAS (CATMULL-ROM SPLINE FECHADA -> SVG PATH)
        // =====================================================================
        const EDITOR_STORAGE_KEY = 'corrida_customizada_track_v1';

        const defaultEditorControlPoints = [
            { x: 160, y: 150 },
            { x: 420, y: 105 },
            { x: 685, y: 155 },
            { x: 730, y: 310 },
            { x: 630, y: 470 },
            { x: 420, y: 430 },
            { x: 220, y: 495 },
            { x: 115, y: 340 }
        ];

        let editorState = {
            name: 'Minha Pista',
            points: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultEditorControlPoints)),
            checkpointT: [0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8], // 5 checkpoints normalizados [0..1)
            startIdx: 0,
            tool: 'add',
            draggingIndex: -1,
            hoveredIndex: -1
        };

        // Converte pontos de controle em caminho SVG fechado suave (Catmull-Rom para Bezier cúbico)
        function catmullRomClosedToSvgPath(pts, tension = 0.5) {
            const len = pts.length;
            if (len < 3) return '';
            let d = `M ${pts[0].x.toFixed(2)},${pts[0].y.toFixed(2)}`;
            for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
                const p0 = pts[(i - 1 + len) % len];
                const p1 = pts[i];
                const p2 = pts[(i + 1) % len];
                const p3 = pts[(i + 2) % len];

                const cp1x = p1.x + (p2.x - p0.x) / 6 * (tension * 2);
                const cp1y = p1.y + (p2.y - p0.y) / 6 * (tension * 2);
                const cp2x = p2.x - (p3.x - p1.x) / 6 * (tension * 2);
                const cp2y = p2.y - (p3.y - p1.y) / 6 * (tension * 2);

                d += ` C ${cp1x.toFixed(2)},${cp1y.toFixed(2)} ${cp2x.toFixed(2)},${cp2y.toFixed(2)} ${p2.x.toFixed(2)},${p2.y.toFixed(2)}`;
            }
            d += ' Z';
            return d;
        }

        // Gera marcadores perpendiculares à curva a partir dos valores normalizados checkpointT
        function computeMarkersFromSvgPath(svgD, cpTs) {
            const probe = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'path');
            probe.setAttribute('d', svgD);
            const total = probe.getTotalLength();
            const halfLen = 7.6;

            return cpTs.map(t => {
                const normT = ((t % 1) + 1) % 1;
                const dist = normT * total;
                const p = probe.getPointAtLength(dist);
                const pPrev = probe.getPointAtLength((dist - 2 + total) % total);
                const pNext = probe.getPointAtLength((dist + 2) % total);

                const angle = Math.atan2(pNext.y - pPrev.y, pNext.x - pPrev.x);
                const nx = -Math.sin(angle);
                const ny = Math.cos(angle);

                return {
                    x1: +(p.x - nx * halfLen).toFixed(2),
                    y1: +(p.y - ny * halfLen).toFixed(2),
                    x2: +(p.x + nx * halfLen).toFixed(2),
                    y2: +(p.y + ny * halfLen).toFixed(2)
                };
            });
        }

        function compileCustomTrackPreset(stateObj) {
            const d = catmullRomClosedToSvgPath(stateObj.points);
            const markers = computeMarkersFromSvgPath(d, stateObj.checkpointT);
            const preset = {
                name: stateObj.name || 'Pista Customizada',
                file: 'custom_editor',
                d,
                svgRoad: 12,
                svgBorder: 16,
                asphalt: '#414042',
                startMarker: stateObj.startIdx || 0,
                markers
            };
            preset.geo = buildTrackGeometry(preset);
            return preset;
        }

        function saveCustomTrackToStorage() {
            try {
                const payload = {
                    name: editorState.name,
                    points: editorState.points,
                    checkpointT: editorState.checkpointT,
                    startIdx: editorState.startIdx
                };
                localStorage.setItem(EDITOR_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(payload));
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('Não foi possível salvar no localStorage:', e);
            }
        }

        function loadCustomTrackFromStorage() {
            try {
                const raw = localStorage.getItem(EDITOR_STORAGE_KEY) || localStorage.getItem('custom_racer_custom_track_v1');
                if (raw) {
                    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
                    if (Array.isArray(parsed.points) && parsed.points.length >= 4) {
                        editorState.name = parsed.name || 'Minha Pista';
                        editorState.points = parsed.points;
                        editorState.checkpointT = Array.isArray(parsed.checkpointT) && parsed.checkpointT.length === 5
                            ? parsed.checkpointT
                            : [0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8];
                        editorState.startIdx = typeof parsed.startIdx === 'number' ? parsed.startIdx : 0;
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('Erro ao carregar pista salva:', e);
            }
            document.getElementById('custom-track-name-input').value = editorState.name;
            trackPresets.custom = compileCustomTrackPreset(editorState);
            updateCustomTrackCardUI();
        }

        function updateCustomTrackCardUI() {
            const titleEl = document.getElementById('custom-track-card-title');
            const descEl = document.getElementById('custom-track-card-desc');
            if (titleEl && trackPresets.custom) {
                titleEl.innerText = trackPresets.custom.name;
            }
            if (descEl) {
                descEl.innerText = `${editorState.points.length} curvas personalizadas e 5 checkpoints prontos.`;
            }
        }

        // Constrói todas as geometrias iniciais
        Object.values(trackPresets).forEach(t => { t.geo = buildTrackGeometry(t); });
        loadCustomTrackFromStorage();

        let currentTrack = null;
        let trackCenterPath = [];
        let TOTAL_PATH_POINTS = 0;
        let checkpoints = [];

        function loadSelectedTrack(trackKey) {
            selectedTrackKey = trackKey;
            currentTrack = trackPresets[trackKey] || trackPresets.track1;
            trackCenterPath = currentTrack.geo.path;
            TOTAL_PATH_POINTS = trackCenterPath.length;
            checkpoints = currentTrack.geo.checkpoints;
        }
        loadSelectedTrack(selectedTrackKey);

        function drawTrackPreviews() {
            Object.keys(trackPresets).forEach(key => {
                const cvs = document.getElementById(`map-preview-${key}`);
                if (!cvs) return;
                const t = trackPresets[key];
                const pCtx = cvs.getContext('2d');
                const sc = Math.min(cvs.width / SVG_W, cvs.height / SVG_H);

                pCtx.clearRect(0, 0, cvs.width, cvs.height);
                pCtx.fillStyle = COL_GRASS;
                pCtx.fillRect(0, 0, cvs.width, cvs.height);

                pCtx.save();
                pCtx.translate((cvs.width - SVG_W * sc) / 2, (cvs.height - SVG_H * sc) / 2);
                pCtx.scale(sc, sc);

                pCtx.strokeStyle = COL_FIELD_EDGE;
                pCtx.lineWidth = 1;
                pCtx.strokeRect(0.5, 0.5, 841.89, 595.28);

                pCtx.lineJoin = 'round';
                pCtx.lineCap = 'round';
                pCtx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
                pCtx.lineWidth = t.svgBorder;
                pCtx.stroke(t.geo.border2D);

                pCtx.strokeStyle = t.asphalt;
                pCtx.lineWidth = t.svgRoad;
                pCtx.stroke(t.geo.path2D);

                pCtx.lineWidth = 6;
                t.markers.forEach((m, i) => {
                    pCtx.strokeStyle = (i === t.startMarker) ? COL_PINK : COL_GOLD;
                    pCtx.beginPath();
                    pCtx.moveTo(m.x1, m.y1);
                    pCtx.lineTo(m.x2, m.y2);
                    pCtx.stroke();
                });

                pCtx.restore();
            });
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // RENDERIZAÇÃO E INTERAÇÃO DO CANVAS DO EDITOR
        // =====================================================================
        const editorCanvas = document.getElementById('editorCanvas');
        const editorCtx = editorCanvas.getContext('2d');
        const editorWrapper = document.getElementById('editor-canvas-wrapper');

        function resizeEditorCanvas() {
            const rect = editorWrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
            const availW = Math.max(260, rect.width - 16);
            const availH = Math.max(180, rect.height - 16);
            const aspect = SVG_W / SVG_H;

            let w = availW;
            let h = w / aspect;
            if (h > availH) {
                h = availH;
                w = h * aspect;
            }
            editorCanvas.width = Math.floor(w);
            editorCanvas.height = Math.floor(h);
            renderEditorCanvas();
        }

        function clientToSvgCoords(clientX, clientY) {
            const rect = editorCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
            const sx = ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * SVG_W;
            const sy = ((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * SVG_H;
            return {
                x: Math.max(30, Math.min(SVG_W - 30, sx)),
                y: Math.max(30, Math.min(SVG_H - 30, sy))
            };
        }

        function showEditorToast(msg) {
            const el = document.getElementById('editor-toast');
            el.innerText = msg;
            el.classList.remove('hidden');
            clearTimeout(el._timer);
            el._timer = setTimeout(() => el.classList.add('hidden'), 2000);
        }

        function findNearestTOnSpline(svgPt) {
            const d = catmullRomClosedToSvgPath(editorState.points);
            if (!d) return 0;
            const probe = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'path');
            probe.setAttribute('d', d);
            const total = probe.getTotalLength();
            const samples = 240;
            let bestT = 0;
            let bestDist = Infinity;

            for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
                const t = i / samples;
                const p = probe.getPointAtLength(t * total);
                const dist = (p.x - svgPt.x) ** 2 + (p.y - svgPt.y) ** 2;
                if (dist < bestDist) {
                    bestDist = dist;
                    bestT = t;
                }
            }
            return bestT;
        }

        function renderEditorCanvas() {
            const W = editorCanvas.width;
            const H = editorCanvas.height;
            const sc = W / SVG_W;

            editorCtx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
            editorCtx.fillStyle = COL_GRASS;
            editorCtx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

            editorCtx.save();
            editorCtx.scale(sc, sc);

            // Grade sutil de referência
            editorCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)';
            editorCtx.lineWidth = 1;
            for (let gx = 50; gx < SVG_W; gx += 50) {
                editorCtx.beginPath();
                editorCtx.moveTo(gx, 0);
                editorCtx.lineTo(gx, SVG_H);
                editorCtx.stroke();
            }
            for (let gy = 50; gy < SVG_H; gy += 50) {
                editorCtx.beginPath();
                editorCtx.moveTo(0, gy);
                editorCtx.lineTo(SVG_W, gy);
                editorCtx.stroke();
            }

            // Borda externa segura
            editorCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)';
            editorCtx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
            editorCtx.strokeRect(30, 30, SVG_W - 60, SVG_H - 60);
            editorCtx.setLineDash([]);

            const pts = editorState.points;
            document.getElementById('editor-point-count').innerText = `Pontos: ${pts.length}`;

            if (pts.length >= 3) {
                const d = catmullRomClosedToSvgPath(pts);
                const path2D = new Path2D(d);

                // Zebra / borda branca
                editorCtx.lineJoin = 'round';
                editorCtx.lineCap = 'round';
                editorCtx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
                editorCtx.lineWidth = 16;
                editorCtx.stroke(path2D);

                // Asfalto
                editorCtx.strokeStyle = '#414042';
                editorCtx.lineWidth = 12;
                editorCtx.stroke(path2D);

                // Linha tracejada central
                editorCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)';
                editorCtx.lineWidth = 1.2;
                editorCtx.setLineDash([6, 8]);
                editorCtx.stroke(path2D);
                editorCtx.setLineDash([]);

                // Desenha os 5 checkpoints e a largada
                const markers = computeMarkersFromSvgPath(d, editorState.checkpointT);
                const probe = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'path');
                probe.setAttribute('d', d);
                const total = probe.getTotalLength();

                // Ordena para exibir a numeração real de corrida (CP 1 = Largada)
                const ordered = markers.map((m, idx) => ({
                    marker: m,
                    rawIdx: idx,
                    t: ((editorState.checkpointT[idx] - editorState.checkpointT[editorState.startIdx]) + 1) % 1
                })).sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);

                ordered.forEach((item, raceOrder) => {
                    const m = item.marker;
                    const isStart = (item.rawIdx === editorState.startIdx);

                    editorCtx.strokeStyle = isStart ? COL_PINK : COL_GOLD;
                    editorCtx.lineWidth = 5;
                    editorCtx.beginPath();
                    editorCtx.moveTo(m.x1, m.y1);
                    editorCtx.lineTo(m.x2, m.y2);
                    editorCtx.stroke();

                    const mx = (m.x1 + m.x2) / 2;
                    const my = (m.y1 + m.y2) / 2;

                    editorCtx.fillStyle = isStart ? COL_PINK : '#0f172a';
                    editorCtx.beginPath();
                    editorCtx.arc(mx, my - 13, 8.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    editorCtx.fill();
                    editorCtx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
                    editorCtx.lineWidth = 1.2;
                    editorCtx.stroke();

                    editorCtx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                    editorCtx.font = 'bold 9px "Russo One", sans-serif';
                    editorCtx.textAlign = 'center';
                    editorCtx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                    editorCtx.fillText(isStart ? 'L' : `${raceOrder + 1}`, mx, my - 12.5);
                });

                // Seta indicando sentido da pista logo após a largada
                const startT = editorState.checkpointT[editorState.startIdx];
                const pA = probe.getPointAtLength(((startT + 0.03) % 1) * total);
                const pB = probe.getPointAtLength(((startT + 0.045) % 1) * total);
                const dirAngle = Math.atan2(pB.y - pA.y, pB.x - pA.x);

                editorCtx.save();
                editorCtx.translate(pA.x, pA.y);
                editorCtx.rotate(dirAngle);
                editorCtx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
                editorCtx.beginPath();
                editorCtx.moveTo(7, 0);
                editorCtx.lineTo(-5, -5);
                editorCtx.lineTo(-2, 0);
                editorCtx.lineTo(-5, 5);
                editorCtx.closePath();
                editorCtx.fill();
                editorCtx.restore();
            } else if (pts.length === 2) {
                editorCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
                editorCtx.lineWidth = 4;
                editorCtx.beginPath();
                editorCtx.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
                editorCtx.lineTo(pts[1].x, pts[1].y);
                editorCtx.stroke();
            }

            // Desenha os nós (pontos de controle)
            pts.forEach((pt, idx) => {
                const isHovered = (idx === editorState.hoveredIndex || idx === editorState.draggingIndex);
                const isFirst = (idx === 0);

                editorCtx.beginPath();
                editorCtx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, isHovered ? 9 : 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                editorCtx.fillStyle = editorState.tool === 'delete'
                    ? '#ef4444'
                    : (isFirst ? '#e50088' : '#38bdf8');
                editorCtx.fill();
                editorCtx.lineWidth = 2;
                editorCtx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
                editorCtx.stroke();

                editorCtx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                editorCtx.font = 'bold 8px sans-serif';
                editorCtx.textAlign = 'center';
                editorCtx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                editorCtx.fillText(idx + 1, pt.x, pt.y);
            });

            editorCtx.restore();
        }

        function findHitControlPoint(svgPt, radius = 16) {
            let bestIdx = -1;
            let bestDist = radius * radius;
            editorState.points.forEach((pt, idx) => {
                const d = (pt.x - svgPt.x) ** 2 + (pt.y - svgPt.y) ** 2;
                if (d < bestDist) {
                    bestDist = d;
                    bestIdx = idx;
                }
            });
            return bestIdx;
        }

        function findBestSegmentInsertIndex(svgPt) {
            const pts = editorState.points;
            if (pts.length < 3) return pts.length;
            let bestIdx = pts.length;
            let bestDist = Infinity;

            for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
                const a = pts[i];
                const b = pts[(i + 1) % pts.length];
                const abx = b.x - a.x;
                const aby = b.y - a.y;
                const abLenSq = abx * abx + aby * aby || 1;
                const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((svgPt.x - a.x) * abx + (svgPt.y - a.y) * aby) / abLenSq));
                const projX = a.x + t * abx;
                const projY = a.y + t * aby;
                const dist = (svgPt.x - projX) ** 2 + (svgPt.y - projY) ** 2;
                if (dist < bestDist) {
                    bestDist = dist;
                    bestIdx = i + 1;
                }
            }
            return bestIdx;
        }

        function setupEditorEvents() {
            const getEventPos = (e) => {
                if (e.touches && e.touches.length > 0) {
                    return clientToSvgCoords(e.touches[0].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY);
                }
                return clientToSvgCoords(e.clientX, e.clientY);
            };

            const onPointerDown = (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const pos = getEventPos(e);
                const hitIdx = findHitControlPoint(pos, 18);

                if (editorState.tool === 'add') {
                    if (hitIdx !== -1) {
                        editorState.draggingIndex = hitIdx;
                    } else {
                        const insertIdx = findBestSegmentInsertIndex(pos);
                        editorState.points.splice(insertIdx, 0, pos);
                        editorState.draggingIndex = insertIdx;
                    }
                    renderEditorCanvas();
                } else if (editorState.tool === 'delete') {
                    if (hitIdx !== -1) {
                        if (editorState.points.length <= 4) {
                            showEditorToast('A pista precisa de pelo menos 4 pontos!');
                            return;
                        }
                        editorState.points.splice(hitIdx, 1);
                        editorState.hoveredIndex = -1;
                        renderEditorCanvas();
                    }
                } else if (editorState.tool === 'checkpoint') {
                    if (editorState.points.length < 4) {
                        showEditorToast('Desenhe pelo menos 4 pontos antes!');
                        return;
                    }
                    const clickedT = findNearestTOnSpline(pos);
                    // Substitui o checkpoint mais próximo do clique
                    let nearestCp = 0;
                    let minDiff = Infinity;
                    editorState.checkpointT.forEach((t, idx) => {
                        const diff = Math.min(Math.abs(t - clickedT), 1 - Math.abs(t - clickedT));
                        if (diff < minDiff) {
                            minDiff = diff;
                            nearestCp = idx;
                        }
                    });
                    editorState.checkpointT[nearestCp] = clickedT;
                    renderEditorCanvas();
                } else if (editorState.tool === 'start') {
                    if (editorState.points.length < 4) {
                        showEditorToast('Desenhe pelo menos 4 pontos antes!');
                        return;
                    }
                    const clickedT = findNearestTOnSpline(pos);
                    // Escolhe o checkpoint mais próximo para virar a linha de largada
                    let nearestCp = 0;
                    let minDiff = Infinity;
                    editorState.checkpointT.forEach((t, idx) => {
                        const diff = Math.min(Math.abs(t - clickedT), 1 - Math.abs(t - clickedT));
                        if (diff < minDiff) {
                            minDiff = diff;
                            nearestCp = idx;
                        }
                    });
                    editorState.checkpointT[nearestCp] = clickedT;
                    editorState.startIdx = nearestCp;
                    renderEditorCanvas();
                }
            };

            const onPointerMove = (e) => {
                const pos = getEventPos(e);
                if (editorState.draggingIndex !== -1) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    editorState.points[editorState.draggingIndex] = pos;
                    renderEditorCanvas();
                } else {
                    const hover = findHitControlPoint(pos, 18);
                    if (hover !== editorState.hoveredIndex) {
                        editorState.hoveredIndex = hover;
                        renderEditorCanvas();
                    }
                }
            };

            const onPointerUp = () => {
                editorState.draggingIndex = -1;
            };

            editorCanvas.addEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
            window.addEventListener('mousemove', onPointerMove);
            window.addEventListener('mouseup', onPointerUp);

            editorCanvas.addEventListener('touchstart', onPointerDown, { passive: false });
            editorCanvas.addEventListener('touchmove', onPointerMove, { passive: false });
            window.addEventListener('touchend', onPointerUp);

            // Botões de ferramenta
            const hints = {
                add: 'Clique para adicionar pontos (mín. 4). Arraste pontos existentes para ajustar a curva.',
                delete: 'Clique sobre um ponto numerado para removê-lo da pista.',
                checkpoint: 'Clique sobre o asfalto para reposicionar o checkpoint mais próximo.',
                start: 'Clique sobre o asfalto para definir onde fica a linha de Largada / Chegada.'
            };

            document.querySelectorAll('#editor-tools .ed-tool-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    document.querySelectorAll('#editor-tools .ed-tool-btn').forEach(b => {
                        b.className = 'ed-tool-btn bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-slate-300 font-russo text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1.5';
                    });
                    btn.className = 'ed-tool-btn bg-cyan-500/20 border border-cyan-400 text-cyan-300 font-russo text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1.5';
                    editorState.tool = btn.dataset.tool;
                    document.getElementById('editor-hint').innerText = hints[editorState.tool];
                    renderEditorCanvas();
                });
            });

            document.getElementById('btn-ed-auto-cp').addEventListener('click', () => {
                editorState.checkpointT = [0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8];
                editorState.startIdx = 0;
                renderEditorCanvas();
                showEditorToast('5 Checkpoints distribuídos igualmente!');
            });

            document.getElementById('btn-ed-reverse').addEventListener('click', () => {
                // Mantém o ponto 1 no lugar para os checkpoints continuarem sobre o mesmo trecho do asfalto
                const [firstPt, ...restPts] = editorState.points;
                editorState.points = firstPt ? [firstPt, ...restPts.reverse()] : [];
                editorState.checkpointT = editorState.checkpointT.map(t => (1 - t) % 1);
                renderEditorCanvas();
                showEditorToast('Sentido da pista invertido!');
            });

            document.getElementById('btn-ed-preset').addEventListener('click', () => {
                editorState.points = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultEditorControlPoints));
                editorState.checkpointT = [0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8];
                editorState.startIdx = 0;
                renderEditorCanvas();
                showEditorToast('Traçado base restaurado!');
            });

            document.getElementById('btn-ed-clear').addEventListener('click', () => {
                editorState.points = [];
                editorState.checkpointT = [0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8];
                editorState.startIdx = 0;
                renderEditorCanvas();
                showEditorToast('Clique na área verde para criar novos pontos!');
            });

            const commitCustomTrack = () => {
                if (editorState.points.length < 4) {
                    showEditorToast('Adicione pelo menos 4 pontos para formar um circuito!');
                    return false;
                }
                const rawName = document.getElementById('custom-track-name-input').value.trim();
                editorState.name = rawName || 'Minha Pista';
                trackPresets.custom = compileCustomTrackPreset(editorState);
                saveCustomTrackToStorage();
                updateCustomTrackCardUI();
                selectedTrackKey = 'custom';
                return true;
            };

            document.getElementById('btn-ed-save').addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (!commitCustomTrack()) return;
                showEditorToast(`"${editorState.name}" salva com sucesso!`);
            });

            document.getElementById('btn-ed-test-race').addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (!commitCustomTrack()) return;
                document.getElementById('track-editor-screen').classList.add('hidden');
                startRace();
            });
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // GARAGEM, CARROS E FÍSICA DA CORRIDA
        // =====================================================================
        const VEHICLE_MODELS = ['tokyo', 'alfetta', 'uno', 'formula'];

        const carConfig = {
            model: 'tokyo',
            color: '#e50088'
        };

        let playerStats = {
            maxSpeed: 4.1,
            accel: 0.11,
            grip: 0.052
        };

        function recalculateStats() {
            playerStats.maxSpeed = 4.1;
            playerStats.accel = 0.11;
            playerStats.grip = 0.052;

            drawCarPreview();
            drawVehicleThumbnails();
        }

        function getClosestTrackPoint(x, y, hint = null, back = 0, ahead = 0) {
            let minDist = Infinity;
            let closestIdx = 0;
            const test = (i) => {
                const p = trackCenterPath[i];
                const d = (x - p.x) ** 2 + (y - p.y) ** 2;
                if (d < minDist) { minDist = d; closestIdx = i; }
            };
            if (hint === null) {
                for (let i = 0; i < TOTAL_PATH_POINTS; i++) test(i);
            } else {
                for (let k = -back; k <= ahead; k++) test((hint + k + TOTAL_PATH_POINTS) % TOTAL_PATH_POINTS);
            }
            return { point: trackCenterPath[closestIdx], index: closestIdx, distance: Math.sqrt(minDist) };
        }

        // Desenha os 4 modelos SVG fielmente orientados para a direita (+X = frente do carro)
        function drawCar(targetCtx, x, y, angle, color, modelType = 'tokyo', scale = 1) {
            targetCtx.save();
            targetCtx.translate(x, y);
            targetCtx.rotate(angle);
            targetCtx.scale(scale, scale);

            const L = 46; // comprimento base do veículo (px)
            const strokeDark = '#18181b';

            if (modelType === 'tokyo') {
                // TOKYOdrift.svg (esportivo coupé com vidros laterais azul-claros, para-brisa/vigia escuros e faróis)
                const s = L / 252;
                targetCtx.scale(s, s);
                targetCtx.translate(-126, -79);
                targetCtx.lineJoin = 'round';
                targetCtx.lineCap = 'round';

                // Carroceria principal pintada
                targetCtx.fillStyle = color;
                targetCtx.strokeStyle = strokeDark;
                targetCtx.lineWidth = 5;
                targetCtx.beginPath();
                targetCtx.moveTo(4, 79);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(3, 52, 12, 34, 22, 24);
                targetCtx.lineTo(66, 8);
                targetCtx.lineTo(136, 11);
                targetCtx.lineTo(212, 7);
                targetCtx.lineTo(243, 28);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(255, 58, 255, 100, 243, 130);
                targetCtx.lineTo(212, 151);
                targetCtx.lineTo(136, 147);
                targetCtx.lineTo(66, 149);
                targetCtx.lineTo(22, 132);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(12, 122, 3, 104, 4, 79);
                targetCtx.closePath();
                targetCtx.fill();
                targetCtx.stroke();

                // Vidro traseiro escuro
                targetCtx.fillStyle = '#18181b';
                targetCtx.beginPath();
                targetCtx.moveTo(31, 79);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(30, 42, 48, 28, 72, 32);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(85, 34, 92, 42, 92, 54);
                targetCtx.lineTo(92, 104);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(92, 116, 85, 124, 72, 126);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(48, 130, 30, 116, 31, 79);
                targetCtx.closePath();
                targetCtx.fill();

                // Para-brisa dianteiro escuro
                targetCtx.beginPath();
                targetCtx.moveTo(148, 42);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(147, 30, 162, 18, 178, 21);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(202, 25, 209, 55, 209, 79);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(209, 103, 202, 133, 178, 137);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(162, 140, 147, 128, 148, 116);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(152, 92, 152, 66, 148, 42);
                targetCtx.closePath();
                targetCtx.fill();

                // Vidros laterais (azul-claro)
                targetCtx.fillStyle = '#bfd3dc';
                targetCtx.strokeStyle = strokeDark;
                targetCtx.lineWidth = 3;
                targetCtx.beginPath();
                targetCtx.moveTo(92, 23);
                targetCtx.lineTo(170, 19);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(145, 34, 106, 38, 92, 23);
                targetCtx.closePath();
                targetCtx.fill();
                targetCtx.stroke();

                targetCtx.beginPath();
                targetCtx.moveTo(90, 135);
                targetCtx.lineTo(168, 139);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(143, 124, 104, 120, 90, 135);
                targetCtx.closePath();
                targetCtx.fill();
                targetCtx.stroke();

                // Faróis dianteiros
                targetCtx.fillStyle = '#18181b';
                targetCtx.beginPath();
                targetCtx.moveTo(232, 25);
                targetCtx.lineTo(244, 34);
                targetCtx.lineTo(246, 54);
                targetCtx.lineTo(238, 51);
                targetCtx.closePath();
                targetCtx.fill();

                targetCtx.beginPath();
                targetCtx.moveTo(232, 133);
                targetCtx.lineTo(244, 124);
                targetCtx.lineTo(246, 104);
                targetCtx.lineTo(238, 107);
                targetCtx.closePath();
                targetCtx.fill();

            } else if (modelType === 'alfetta') {
                // ALFETTA169!¨(.svg (monoposto clássico com pneus expostos, cockpit caramelo, capô preto e escapamento lateral)
                const s = L / 300;
                targetCtx.scale(s, s);
                targetCtx.translate(-150, -75);
                targetCtx.lineJoin = 'round';
                targetCtx.lineCap = 'round';

                const drawWheel = (wx, wy, ww, wh) => {
                    targetCtx.fillStyle = '#383838';
                    targetCtx.strokeStyle = strokeDark;
                    targetCtx.lineWidth = 4;
                    targetCtx.beginPath();
                    targetCtx.roundRect(wx, wy, ww, wh, 11);
                    targetCtx.fill();
                    targetCtx.stroke();
                };

                // 4 pneus expostos
                drawWheel(50, 8, 56, 28);
                drawWheel(45, 116, 56, 28);
                drawWheel(232, 4, 56, 28);
                drawWheel(231, 114, 56, 28);

                // Fuselagem alongada pontiaguda atrás
                targetCtx.fillStyle = color;
                targetCtx.strokeStyle = strokeDark;
                targetCtx.lineWidth = 4;
                targetCtx.beginPath();
                targetCtx.moveTo(4, 80);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(26, 55, 50, 42, 82, 37);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(135, 30, 185, 31, 232, 34);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(260, 27, 296, 30, 297, 74);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(298, 106, 272, 115, 254, 115);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(212, 110, 140, 124, 72, 122);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(44, 117, 22, 102, 4, 80);
                targetCtx.closePath();
                targetCtx.fill();
                targetCtx.stroke();

                // Assento / cockpit caramelo
                targetCtx.fillStyle = '#b49456';
                targetCtx.strokeStyle = strokeDark;
                targetCtx.lineWidth = 3.5;
                targetCtx.beginPath();
                targetCtx.moveTo(85, 44);
                targetCtx.lineTo(124, 41);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(135, 62, 135, 92, 121, 111);
                targetCtx.lineTo(87, 109);
                targetCtx.closePath();
                targetCtx.fill();
                targetCtx.stroke();

                // Cobertura do motor (retângulo preto)
                targetCtx.fillStyle = '#18181b';
                targetCtx.fillRect(169, 49, 93, 44);

                // Escapamento lateral cinza
                targetCtx.fillStyle = '#7e8184';
                targetCtx.strokeStyle = strokeDark;
                targetCtx.lineWidth = 3.5;
                targetCtx.beginPath();
                targetCtx.moveTo(177, 93);
                targetCtx.lineTo(235, 93);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(238, 112, 226, 121, 211, 125);
                targetCtx.lineTo(171, 129);
                targetCtx.lineTo(171, 133);
                targetCtx.lineTo(64, 132);
                targetCtx.lineTo(26, 126);
                targetCtx.lineTo(26, 120);
                targetCtx.lineTo(50, 116);
                targetCtx.lineTo(66, 122);
                targetCtx.lineTo(166, 122);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(177, 118, 181, 106, 177, 93);
                targetCtx.closePath();
                targetCtx.fill();
                targetCtx.stroke();

            } else if (modelType === 'uno') {
                // UNOCONEXCADA.svg (frente chanfrada, teto escuro e escada laranja no teto!)
                const s = L / 245;
                targetCtx.scale(s, s);
                targetCtx.translate(-122, -79);
                targetCtx.lineJoin = 'round';
                targetCtx.lineCap = 'round';

                // 4 rodas
                targetCtx.fillStyle = '#383838';
                targetCtx.strokeStyle = strokeDark;
                targetCtx.lineWidth = 4;
                targetCtx.fillRect(4, 4, 42, 18);
                targetCtx.strokeRect(4, 4, 42, 18);
                targetCtx.fillRect(129, 4, 42, 18);
                targetCtx.strokeRect(129, 4, 42, 18);
                targetCtx.fillRect(5, 137, 42, 18);
                targetCtx.strokeRect(5, 137, 42, 18);
                targetCtx.fillRect(135, 136, 42, 18);
                targetCtx.strokeRect(135, 136, 42, 18);

                // Carroceria do Uno
                targetCtx.fillStyle = color;
                targetCtx.strokeStyle = strokeDark;
                targetCtx.lineWidth = 4.5;
                targetCtx.beginPath();
                targetCtx.moveTo(4, 22);
                targetCtx.lineTo(171, 22);
                targetCtx.lineTo(241, 44);
                targetCtx.lineTo(240, 108);
                targetCtx.lineTo(177, 136);
                targetCtx.lineTo(5, 137);
                targetCtx.closePath();
                targetCtx.fill();
                targetCtx.stroke();

                // Para-brisa escuro
                targetCtx.fillStyle = '#383838';
                targetCtx.fillRect(135, 37, 38, 82);
                targetCtx.strokeRect(135, 37, 38, 82);

                // Degraus cinzas da escada
                targetCtx.fillStyle = '#7e8184';
                const rungs = [17, 36, 57, 78, 98, 118, 138, 159, 179, 199];
                rungs.forEach(rx => {
                    targetCtx.fillRect(rx, 65, 9, 25);
                    targetCtx.strokeRect(rx, 65, 9, 25);
                });

                // Longarinas laranjas da escada no teto
                targetCtx.fillStyle = '#ef5523';
                targetCtx.fillRect(9, 53, 208, 12);
                targetCtx.strokeRect(9, 53, 208, 12);
                targetCtx.fillRect(10, 90, 208, 12);
                targetCtx.strokeRect(10, 90, 208, 12);

            } else {
                // Formula1F!!.svg (monoposto moderno com asa traseira, sidepods escuros, bico e asa dianteira)
                const s = L / 285;
                targetCtx.scale(s, s);
                targetCtx.translate(-142, -72);
                targetCtx.lineJoin = 'round';
                targetCtx.lineCap = 'round';

                const drawF1Wheel = (wx, wy, ww, wh) => {
                    targetCtx.fillStyle = '#383838';
                    targetCtx.strokeStyle = strokeDark;
                    targetCtx.lineWidth = 4;
                    targetCtx.beginPath();
                    targetCtx.roundRect(wx, wy, ww, wh, 8);
                    targetCtx.fill();
                    targetCtx.stroke();
                };

                // Pneus traseiros largos e dianteiros
                drawF1Wheel(22, 4, 38, 30);
                drawF1Wheel(19, 108, 38, 30);
                drawF1Wheel(200, 6, 38, 28);
                drawF1Wheel(199, 114, 38, 28);

                // Assoalho / braços de suspensão escuros
                targetCtx.fillStyle = '#383838';
                targetCtx.strokeStyle = strokeDark;
                targetCtx.lineWidth = 3.5;
                targetCtx.beginPath();
                targetCtx.moveTo(28, 34);
                targetCtx.lineTo(54, 35);
                targetCtx.lineTo(59, 27);
                targetCtx.lineTo(92, 21);
                targetCtx.lineTo(147, 19);
                targetCtx.lineTo(169, 30);
                targetCtx.lineTo(182, 57);
                targetCtx.lineTo(196, 57);
                targetCtx.lineTo(207, 40);
                targetCtx.lineTo(203, 33);
                targetCtx.lineTo(228, 34);
                targetCtx.lineTo(222, 40);
                targetCtx.lineTo(228, 109);
                targetCtx.lineTo(232, 114);
                targetCtx.lineTo(203, 114);
                targetCtx.lineTo(210, 106);
                targetCtx.lineTo(196, 87);
                targetCtx.lineTo(181, 87);
                targetCtx.lineTo(168, 116);
                targetCtx.lineTo(149, 126);
                targetCtx.lineTo(89, 124);
                targetCtx.lineTo(58, 116);
                targetCtx.lineTo(54, 106);
                targetCtx.lineTo(28, 107);
                targetCtx.closePath();
                targetCtx.fill();
                targetCtx.stroke();

                // Chassi principal pintado
                targetCtx.fillStyle = color;
                targetCtx.strokeStyle = strokeDark;
                targetCtx.lineWidth = 3.5;
                targetCtx.beginPath();
                targetCtx.moveTo(41, 56);
                targetCtx.lineTo(53, 55);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(118, 22, 148, 13, 171, 55);
                targetCtx.lineTo(227, 61);
                targetCtx.lineTo(266, 61);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(279, 63, 279, 82, 266, 84);
                targetCtx.lineTo(227, 83);
                targetCtx.lineTo(171, 89);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(148, 131, 118, 122, 53, 86);
                targetCtx.lineTo(41, 84);
                targetCtx.closePath();
                targetCtx.fill();
                targetCtx.stroke();

                // Asa traseira pintada
                targetCtx.beginPath();
                targetCtx.moveTo(3, 27);
                targetCtx.lineTo(30, 30);
                targetCtx.lineTo(30, 112);
                targetCtx.lineTo(3, 115);
                targetCtx.closePath();
                targetCtx.fill();
