                targetCtx.stroke();

                // Asa dianteira pintada
                targetCtx.beginPath();
                targetCtx.moveTo(243, 8);
                targetCtx.lineTo(265, 9);
                targetCtx.lineTo(282, 62);
                targetCtx.lineTo(282, 81);
                targetCtx.lineTo(265, 136);
                targetCtx.lineTo(242, 136);
                targetCtx.lineTo(246, 95);
                targetCtx.lineTo(256, 84);
                targetCtx.lineTo(266, 84);
                targetCtx.bezierCurveTo(279, 82, 279, 63, 266, 61);
                targetCtx.lineTo(256, 61);
                targetCtx.lineTo(247, 49);
                targetCtx.closePath();
                targetCtx.fill();
                targetCtx.stroke();
            }

            targetCtx.restore();
        }

        function drawCarPreview() {
            previewCtx.clearRect(0, 0, previewCanvas.width, previewCanvas.height);
            drawCar(previewCtx, previewCanvas.width / 2, previewCanvas.height / 2, -Math.PI / 2, carConfig.color, carConfig.model, 3.2);
        }

        function drawVehicleThumbnails() {
            VEHICLE_MODELS.forEach(modelKey => {
                const thumb = document.getElementById(`thumb-${modelKey}`);
                if (!thumb) return;
                const tCtx = thumb.getContext('2d');
                tCtx.clearRect(0, 0, thumb.width, thumb.height);
                drawCar(tCtx, thumb.width / 2, thumb.height / 2, 0, carConfig.color, modelKey, 1.35);
            });
        }

        class Car {
            constructor(x, y, color, isAI = false) {
                this.x = x;
                this.y = y;
                this.color = color;
                this.isAI = isAI;
                this.angle = -Math.PI / 2;
                this.speed = 0;
                this.maxSpeed = playerStats.maxSpeed;
                this.accel = isAI ? 0.04 : playerStats.accel;
                this.grip = isAI ? 0.04 : playerStats.grip;
                this.lap = 1;
                this.nextCheckpointIndex = 1;
                this.checkpointsClearedInLap = 1;
                this.totalCheckpointsCleared = 1;
                this.lastPathIndex = 0;
                this.aiSpeedRatio = 0.85;
            }

            update(keys) {
                if (isCountingDown) return;

                const closest = this.isAI
                    ? getClosestTrackPoint(this.x, this.y, this.lastPathIndex, 10, 60)
                    : getClosestTrackPoint(this.x, this.y);
                const isOnTrack = closest.distance <= currentTrack.geo.edgeLimit;

                if (!this.isAI) {
                    const currentMaxSpeed = isOnTrack ? playerStats.maxSpeed : playerStats.maxSpeed * 0.22;
                    const currentAccel = isOnTrack ? playerStats.accel : playerStats.accel * 0.25;

                    if (keys.up) {
                        this.speed = Math.min(currentMaxSpeed, this.speed + currentAccel);
                    } else if (keys.down) {
                        this.speed = Math.max(-0.5, this.speed - currentAccel * 1.2);
                    } else {
                        this.speed *= 0.985;
                        if (Math.abs(this.speed) < 0.01) this.speed = 0;
                    }

                    if (!isOnTrack && Math.abs(this.speed) > currentMaxSpeed) {
                        this.speed *= 0.90;
                    }

                    if (Math.abs(this.speed) > 0.05) {
                        const turnFactor = Math.sign(this.speed) * (isOnTrack ? playerStats.grip : playerStats.grip * 0.55);
                        if (keys.left) this.angle -= turnFactor;
                        if (keys.right) this.angle += turnFactor;
                    }

                    this.x += Math.cos(this.angle) * this.speed;
                    this.y += Math.sin(this.angle) * this.speed;

                } else {
                    const targetIdx = (this.lastPathIndex + AI_LOOKAHEAD) % TOTAL_PATH_POINTS;
                    const target = trackCenterPath[targetIdx];
                    const targetAngle = Math.atan2(target.y - this.y, target.x - this.x);

                    let diffAngle = targetAngle - this.angle;
                    while (diffAngle < -Math.PI) diffAngle += Math.PI * 2;
                    while (diffAngle > Math.PI) diffAngle -= Math.PI * 2;

                    this.angle += Math.sign(diffAngle) * Math.min(Math.abs(diffAngle), 0.10);

                    const effectiveMaxSpeed = playerStats.maxSpeed * this.aiSpeedRatio;
                    const targetSpeed = isOnTrack ? effectiveMaxSpeed : effectiveMaxSpeed * 0.22;
                    this.speed = targetSpeed;

                    this.x += Math.cos(this.angle) * this.speed;
                    this.y += Math.sin(this.angle) * this.speed;
                }

                this.lastPathIndex = closest.index;
                this.checkCheckpointPassing();
            }

            checkCheckpointPassing() {
                const targetCp = checkpoints[this.nextCheckpointIndex];
                const distToCp = Math.hypot(this.x - targetCp.x, this.y - targetCp.y);

                if (distToCp < currentTrack.geo.edgeLimit * 1.25) {
                    const passedIdx = this.nextCheckpointIndex;
                    this.totalCheckpointsCleared++;
                    this.nextCheckpointIndex = (passedIdx + 1) % checkpoints.length;

                    if (this.isAI) {
                        if (passedIdx === 4) {
                            this.aiSpeedRatio = 0.75;
                        } else if (passedIdx === 0) {
                            this.aiSpeedRatio = 0.85;
                        }
                    }

                    if (passedIdx === 0) {
                        this.lap++;
                        this.checkpointsClearedInLap = 1;
                        if (!this.isAI) {
                            if (this.lap > 3) {
                                endRace();
                            } else {
                                showCpToast(`VOLTA ${this.lap} / 3`);
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        this.checkpointsClearedInLap++;
                        if (!this.isAI) showCpToast(`CP ${targetCp.id} OK!`);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        let player;
        let aiCars = [];
        const keys = { up: false, down: false, left: false, right: false };
        let raceStartTime = 0;
        let animId;

        function showCpToast(msg) {
            const toast = document.getElementById('cp-toast');
            toast.innerText = msg;
            toast.classList.remove('hidden');
            clearTimeout(toast._timer);
            toast._timer = setTimeout(() => toast.classList.add('hidden'), 1000);
        }

        let countdownInterval = null;
        let lastFrameTime = 0;
        let accumulator = 0;
        const STEP_MS = 1000 / 60;   // a física foi ajustada para 60 passos por segundo

        function startCountdown(callback) {
            clearInterval(countdownInterval);
            isCountingDown = true;
            const overlay = document.getElementById('countdown-overlay');
            const textElem = document.getElementById('countdown-text');
            overlay.classList.remove('hidden');

            let count = 3;
            textElem.innerText = count;

            countdownInterval = setInterval(() => {
                count--;
                if (count > 0) {
                    textElem.innerText = count;
                } else if (count === 0) {
                    textElem.innerText = "LARGADA!";
                } else {
                    clearInterval(countdownInterval);
                    overlay.classList.add('hidden');
                    isCountingDown = false;
                    if (callback) callback();
                }
            }, 1000);
        }

        function startRace() {
            loadSelectedTrack(selectedTrackKey);
            keys.up = keys.down = keys.left = keys.right = false;

            gameState = STATES.RACING;
            document.getElementById('garage-screen').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('track-select-screen').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('game-over-screen').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('hud').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('touch-controls').classList.remove('hidden');

            const startP = trackCenterPath[0];
            const nextP = trackCenterPath[1];
            const initialAngle = Math.atan2(nextP.y - startP.y, nextP.x - startP.x);

            const tx = Math.cos(initialAngle), ty = Math.sin(initialAngle);
            const nx = -ty, ny = tx;
            const slot = (back, side) => ({ x: startP.x - tx * back + nx * side, y: startP.y - ty * back + ny * side });
            const gridP = slot(40, -15), gridA = slot(40, 15), gridB = slot(95, -15), gridC = slot(95, 15);

            player = new Car(gridP.x, gridP.y, carConfig.color, false);
            player.angle = initialAngle;

            aiCars = [
                new Car(gridA.x, gridA.y, '#3b82f6', true),
                new Car(gridB.x, gridB.y, '#10b981', true),
                new Car(gridC.x, gridC.y, '#f59e0b', true)
            ];

            aiCars.forEach(ai => ai.angle = initialAngle);

            raceStartTime = 0;
            startCountdown(() => {
                raceStartTime = Date.now();
            });

            cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
            lastFrameTime = performance.now();
            accumulator = 0;
            animId = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
        }

        function resolveCarCollisions() {
            const allCars = [player, ...aiCars];
            const radius = 22 * CAR_SCALE;

            for (let i = 0; i < allCars.length; i++) {
                for (let j = i + 1; j < allCars.length; j++) {
                    const c1 = allCars[i];
                    const c2 = allCars[j];

                    const dx = c2.x - c1.x;
                    const dy = c2.y - c1.y;
                    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
                    const minDist = radius * 2;

                    if (dist < minDist && dist > 0) {
                        const overlap = minDist - dist;
                        const nx = dx / dist;
                        const ny = dy / dist;

                        const isPlayerInvolved = (!c1.isAI || !c2.isAI);

                        if (isPlayerInvolved) {
                            if (!c1.isAI) {
                                c1.x -= nx * overlap * 0.2;
                                c1.y -= ny * overlap * 0.2;
                                c2.x += nx * overlap * 0.8;
                                c2.y += ny * overlap * 0.8;
                                c1.speed *= 0.97;
                                c2.speed *= 0.85;
                            } else {
                                c1.x -= nx * overlap * 0.8;
                                c1.y -= ny * overlap * 0.8;
                                c2.x += nx * overlap * 0.2;
                                c2.y += ny * overlap * 0.2;
                                c1.speed *= 0.85;
                                c2.speed *= 0.97;
                            }
                        } else {
                            c1.x -= nx * overlap * 0.5;
                            c1.y -= ny * overlap * 0.5;
                            c2.x += nx * overlap * 0.5;
                            c2.y += ny * overlap * 0.5;
                            c1.speed *= 0.78;
                            c2.speed *= 0.78;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        function drawCheckpoints() {
            const len = TRACK_WIDTH + currentTrack.geo.borderPx * 2;
            const thick = 6 * MAP_SCALE;

            checkpoints.forEach((cp, idx) => {
                const isStartOrFinish = (idx === 0);

                ctx.save();
                ctx.translate(cp.x, cp.y);
                ctx.rotate(cp.angle + Math.PI / 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = isStartOrFinish ? COL_PINK : COL_GOLD;
                ctx.fillRect(-len / 2, -thick / 2, len, thick);
                ctx.restore();

                ctx.save();
                ctx.font = 'bold 17px "Russo One", sans-serif';
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                ctx.lineWidth = 4;
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
                ctx.strokeText(`CP ${cp.id}`, cp.x, cp.y);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                ctx.fillText(`CP ${cp.id}`, cp.x, cp.y);
                ctx.restore();
            });
        }

        function gameLoop(now) {
            if (gameState !== STATES.RACING) return;
            if (typeof now !== 'number') now = performance.now();

            accumulator += Math.min(now - lastFrameTime, 100);
            lastFrameTime = now;
            let steps = 0;
            while (accumulator >= STEP_MS && steps < 5) {
                player.update(keys);
                aiCars.forEach(ai => ai.update());
                resolveCarCollisions();
                accumulator -= STEP_MS;
                steps++;
                if (gameState !== STATES.RACING) break;
            }

            ctx.fillStyle = '#006838';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(canvas.width / 2 - player.x, canvas.height / 2 - player.y);

            ctx.strokeStyle = COL_FIELD_EDGE;
            ctx.lineWidth = 3;
            ctx.strokeRect(0, 0, SVG_W * MAP_SCALE, SVG_H * MAP_SCALE);

            ctx.save();
            ctx.scale(MAP_SCALE, MAP_SCALE);
            ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
            ctx.lineCap = 'round';

            ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.lineWidth = (TRACK_WIDTH + currentTrack.geo.borderPx * 2) / MAP_SCALE;
            ctx.stroke(currentTrack.geo.border2D);

            ctx.strokeStyle = currentTrack.asphalt;
            ctx.lineWidth = TRACK_WIDTH / MAP_SCALE;
            ctx.stroke(currentTrack.geo.path2D);

            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 4 / MAP_SCALE;
            ctx.setLineDash([20 / MAP_SCALE, 30 / MAP_SCALE]);
            ctx.stroke(currentTrack.geo.path2D);
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
            ctx.restore();

            drawCheckpoints();

            aiCars.forEach((ai, idx) => {
                const aiModels = ['alfetta', 'uno', 'formula'];
                drawCar(ctx, ai.x, ai.y, ai.angle, ai.color, aiModels[idx % aiModels.length], CAR_SCALE);
            });
            drawCar(ctx, player.x, player.y, player.angle, player.color, carConfig.model, CAR_SCALE);

            ctx.restore();

            drawMinimap();

            document.getElementById('speed-display').innerText = Math.round(Math.abs(player.speed) * 45);
            document.getElementById('pos-display').innerText = `${getPosition()}º / 4`;
            document.getElementById('lap-display').innerText = `${Math.min(3, player.lap)} / 3`;
            document.getElementById('cp-display').innerText = `${Math.max(1, player.checkpointsClearedInLap)} / 5`;

            if (raceStartTime > 0) {
                const elapsed = Date.now() - raceStartTime;
                const secs = (elapsed / 1000).toFixed(1);
                document.getElementById('time-display').innerText = `${secs}s`;
            }

            animId = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
        }

        function getPosition() {
            if (!player) return 1;
            const allRacers = [player, ...aiCars];
            allRacers.sort((a, b) => {
                if (b.totalCheckpointsCleared !== a.totalCheckpointsCleared) {
                    return b.totalCheckpointsCleared - a.totalCheckpointsCleared;
                }
                const nextCpA = checkpoints[a.nextCheckpointIndex];
                const nextCpB = checkpoints[b.nextCheckpointIndex];
                const distA = Math.hypot(a.x - nextCpA.x, a.y - nextCpA.y);
                const distB = Math.hypot(b.x - nextCpB.x, b.y - nextCpB.y);
                return distA - distB;
            });
            return allRacers.indexOf(player) + 1;
        }

        function drawMinimap() {
            const W = minimapCanvas.width, H = minimapCanvas.height;
            const sc = Math.min(W / SVG_W, H / SVG_H);
            const toSvg = 1 / MAP_SCALE;

            minimapCtx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
            minimapCtx.save();
            minimapCtx.translate((W - SVG_W * sc) / 2, (H - SVG_H * sc) / 2);
            minimapCtx.scale(sc, sc);
            minimapCtx.lineJoin = 'round';
            minimapCtx.lineCap = 'round';

            minimapCtx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
            minimapCtx.lineWidth = 30;
            minimapCtx.stroke(currentTrack.geo.border2D);
            minimapCtx.strokeStyle = currentTrack.asphalt;
            minimapCtx.lineWidth = 22;
            minimapCtx.stroke(currentTrack.geo.path2D);

            checkpoints.forEach((cp, i) => {
                minimapCtx.fillStyle = (i === 0) ? COL_PINK : COL_GOLD;
                minimapCtx.beginPath();
                minimapCtx.arc(cp.x * toSvg, cp.y * toSvg, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                minimapCtx.fill();
            });

            aiCars.forEach(ai => {
                minimapCtx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
                minimapCtx.beginPath();
                minimapCtx.arc(ai.x * toSvg, ai.y * toSvg, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                minimapCtx.fill();
            });

            minimapCtx.fillStyle = '#e50088';
            minimapCtx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
            minimapCtx.lineWidth = 3;
            minimapCtx.beginPath();
            minimapCtx.arc(player.x * toSvg, player.y * toSvg, 13, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            minimapCtx.fill();
            minimapCtx.stroke();

            minimapCtx.restore();
        }

        function endRace() {
            if (gameState !== STATES.RACING) return;
            gameState = STATES.GAMEOVER;
            document.getElementById('game-over-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('hud').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('touch-controls').classList.add('hidden');

            const playerPos = getPosition();
            document.getElementById('final-pos').innerText = `${playerPos}º`;
            document.getElementById('final-time').innerText = document.getElementById('time-display').innerText;
        }

        function openTrackEditor(returnScreen = 'garage') {
            document.getElementById('garage-screen').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('track-select-screen').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('track-editor-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('track-editor-screen').dataset.returnScreen = returnScreen;
            resizeEditorCanvas();
        }

        function selectTrackCardUI(trackKey) {
            selectedTrackKey = trackKey;
            document.querySelectorAll('.track-card').forEach(c => {
                c.className = "track-card bg-slate-900 border-2 border-slate-800 p-3 rounded-2xl cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center hover:border-pink-500 transition shadow-lg relative group";
                const title = c.querySelector('h3');
                if (title) title.className = "font-russo text-base text-slate-200 mt-1";
            });

            const activeCard = document.querySelector(`.track-card[data-track="${trackKey}"]`);
            if (activeCard) {
                activeCard.className = "track-card bg-slate-900 border-2 border-pink-500 p-3 rounded-2xl cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center hover:border-pink-400 transition shadow-lg relative group";
                const title = activeCard.querySelector('h3');
                if (title) title.className = "font-russo text-base text-pink-400 mt-1";
            }

            const trackLabel = (trackPresets[trackKey]?.name || 'PISTA 1').toUpperCase();
            document.getElementById('btn-start-race').innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-play text-xl"></i> INICIAR CORRIDA NA ${trackLabel}`;
        }

        function setupControls() {
            window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
                if (document.activeElement && document.activeElement.tagName === 'INPUT') return;
                if (gameState === STATES.RACING && e.code.startsWith('Arrow')) e.preventDefault();
                if (e.code === 'KeyW' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') keys.up = true;
                if (e.code === 'KeyS' || e.code === 'ArrowDown') keys.down = true;
                if (e.code === 'KeyA' || e.code === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = true;
                if (e.code === 'KeyD' || e.code === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = true;
            });

            window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
                if (e.code === 'KeyW' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') keys.up = false;
                if (e.code === 'KeyS' || e.code === 'ArrowDown') keys.down = false;
                if (e.code === 'KeyA' || e.code === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = false;
                if (e.code === 'KeyD' || e.code === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = false;
            });

            window.addEventListener('blur', () => {
                keys.up = keys.down = keys.left = keys.right = false;
            });

            const bindTouch = (elem, keyState) => {
                elem.addEventListener('touchcancel', () => { keys[keyState] = false; });
                elem.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { keys[keyState] = false; });
                elem.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); keys[keyState] = true; });
                elem.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); keys[keyState] = false; });
                elem.addEventListener('mousedown', () => { keys[keyState] = true; });
                elem.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { keys[keyState] = false; });
            };

            bindTouch(document.getElementById('btn-touch-left'), 'left');
            bindTouch(document.getElementById('btn-touch-right'), 'right');
            bindTouch(document.getElementById('btn-touch-accel'), 'up');
            bindTouch(document.getElementById('btn-touch-brake'), 'down');

            document.getElementById('btn-play-game').addEventListener('click', () => {
                document.getElementById('start-screen').classList.add('hidden');
                document.getElementById('garage-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
            });

            document.getElementById('btn-goto-editor').addEventListener('click', () => {
                openTrackEditor('garage');
            });

            document.getElementById('btn-open-editor-from-select').addEventListener('click', () => {
                openTrackEditor('select');
            });

            document.getElementById('btn-editor-back').addEventListener('click', () => {
                const screenEl = document.getElementById('track-editor-screen');
                screenEl.classList.add('hidden');
                if (screenEl.dataset.returnScreen === 'select') {
                    document.getElementById('track-select-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
                    selectTrackCardUI(selectedTrackKey);
                    drawTrackPreviews();
                } else {
                    document.getElementById('garage-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
                }
            });

            document.getElementById('btn-goto-track-select').addEventListener('click', () => {
                document.getElementById('garage-screen').classList.add('hidden');
                document.getElementById('track-select-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
                selectTrackCardUI(selectedTrackKey);
                drawTrackPreviews();
            });

            document.getElementById('btn-back-to-garage').addEventListener('click', () => {
                document.getElementById('track-select-screen').classList.add('hidden');
                document.getElementById('garage-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
            });

            document.querySelectorAll('.track-card').forEach(card => {
                card.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    selectTrackCardUI(card.dataset.track);
                    drawTrackPreviews();
                });
            });

            document.querySelectorAll('#opts-vehicle .vehicle-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    document.querySelectorAll('#opts-vehicle .vehicle-btn').forEach(b => {
                        b.className = "vehicle-btn bg-slate-800/90 border-2 border-slate-700 text-slate-300 font-russo text-xs p-2.5 rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 hover:border-pink-500/60 transition";
                    });
                    btn.className = "vehicle-btn bg-pink-500/20 border-2 border-pink-500 text-white font-russo text-xs p-2.5 rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 transition";
                    carConfig.model = btn.dataset.model;
                    recalculateStats();
                });
            });

            const colorPicker = document.getElementById('car-color-picker');
            const colorHexLabel = document.getElementById('car-color-hex');
            if (colorPicker) {
                colorPicker.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
                    carConfig.color = e.target.value;
                    if (colorHexLabel) colorHexLabel.innerText = e.target.value.toUpperCase();
                    recalculateStats();
                });
            }

            document.getElementById('btn-start-race').addEventListener('click', startRace);
            document.getElementById('btn-restart').addEventListener('click', startRace);
            document.getElementById('btn-back-garage').addEventListener('click', () => {
                document.getElementById('game-over-screen').classList.add('hidden');
                document.getElementById('garage-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
                gameState = STATES.GARAGE;
            });
        }

        setupEditorEvents();
        setupControls();
        recalculateStats();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
